मुनि a lexicographer, probably Kātyāyana. Kṣīrasvāmin
on Amarakośa.

मुनि and मुनीन्द्र a designation of Bharata. Sāhitya-
darpaṇa p. 93. 200.
मुनि Quoted by Utpala in Spandapradīpikā.

मुनि and मुनीन्द्र a designation of Bharata. Sāhitya-
darpaṇa p. 93. 200.
Pāṣaṇḍamukhacapeṭikā q. v.

मुनीन्द्र son of Kavīndra, grandson of Harīndra, wrote
in 1837:
 Māṃsamīmāṃsā.
मुनिचन्द्र a pupil of Vardhamāna. Gaṇaratnamahodadhi p. 3.
मुनिदेव guru of Caṇḍūpaṇḍita (Naiṣadhīyadīpikā).
BA. 8

मुनिदेव आचार्य
 Subhāṣitaratnakośa.
Kaumāravyākaraṇa q. v.

मुनिभावप्रकाशिका vedānta, by Kṛṣṇa Guru. Oppert
5612. II, 1593. 4114.
मुनिभावप्रकाशिका, a C. on the Bhāgavatapurāṇa.
मुनिमतमणिमाला dh. by Vāmadeva. Report XXIII.

मुनिमतमीमांसा kāvya, by Kṣemendra. Quoted in
Aucityavicāracarcā 16. 18. 23--26. 33. 34. 37.
मुनीश्वर the ascetic name of Viśvarūpa, son of Raṅganātha.

विश्वरूप गणक surnamed मुनीश्वर son of Raṅganātha,
grandson of Ballāla Daivajña:
 Commentary on the Cābukayantra of Gaṇeśa.
 Nisṛṣṭārthadūtī Līlāvatīṭīkā.
 Siddhāntaśiromaṇimarīci.
 Siddhāntasārvabhauma.
